Title: Azure SQL—Public preview updates for early March 2022

Body.Content:
In early March 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Increase resiliency of Azure SQL Hyperscale databases using zone redundant configuration.
  • Run T-SQL queries on Azure Data Lake files from your Azure SQL Managed Instance
